name: Idle Words
overview: Scripture warns believers to guard their speech carefully, recognizing that idle words often lead to sin and destruction. The psalmist prays for God's watchful protection over his mouth, highlighting the need for divine help in controlling what we say (Psalms 141:3). Proverbs emphasizes wisdom in restraint, teaching that those who hold their tongues preserve their lives and demonstrate understanding, while excessive or foolish talk results in harm and folly (Proverbs 10:19; 13:3; 15:2; 17:27-28). This calls Christians to exercise self-control and speak with knowledge, reflecting the Spirit's guidance in every conversation.
